# Delivery and Quality Assurance Methodology

## Delivery phases

1. Requirements workshop and sign-off (one to two weeks).
2. Design of screens and user journeys, reviewed with the client.
3. Development in two-week iterations with a demonstration at the end of each.
4. System testing by our QA team.
5. User acceptance testing by the client.
6. Go-live and a warranty period.

Language order: where a site is bilingual we normally deliver the English
pages first and complete the Arabic pages once the English layout is approved
in user acceptance testing.

## Test cases

Our QA team writes test cases from the approved requirements before
development of each iteration starts. Each test case names the requirement it
covers, the steps, the expected result and the actual result. The full test
case set is handed to the client at user acceptance testing.

## Performance testing

We run load tests with Apache JMeter on projects where the client asks for it.
Our largest completed load test is 150 concurrent users (2022). We have not
yet run a test at a higher load on a delivered project, and the results of any
load test depend on the client's own server and network.

## Training and documentation

At handover we deliver an administrator guide and an end-user guide in
English, and run up to two half-day training sessions at the client's premises
for administrators and business users. Arabic user guides are available at
additional cost.

## Source code handover

On final payment the client receives the full source code, database scripts
and deployment instructions, and a one-day walkthrough session for the
client's developers.

## Warranty

We correct defects reported within 30 days of go-live at no charge. Defects
reported after 30 days, including findings from security tests commissioned
by the client, are handled under a separate support agreement.
